The '''Extorin Minor skirmishes''' were a conflict that occurred<ref name="Gamer8" /> at some point by [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The skirmishes shared their name with the [[Extorin Minor system/Legends|Extorin Minor system]], a part of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Extorin sector/Legends|Extorin sector]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> and involved aggressors belonging to the group known as the [[Extorin]]. During the conflict, the Extorin threatened the [[Montitian]]s of<ref name="Gamer8" /> the poor [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> [[Montitia]]<ref name="Gamer8" /> in the Extorin [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] neighboring [[Montitian Grant sector/Legends|Montitian Grant sector]].<ref name="Expansion">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Montitia system/Legends|Montitia system]]</ref>

As part of one of the final campaigns of the Extorin Minor skirmishes, a group of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learners were struggling to protect and rescue the last of Montitia's [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] from a camp on Montitia besieged by the Extorin. In what became known as the legendary [[Montitian Extraction]], [[Charza Kwinn]], a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] allied with the Order, arrived on Montitia in an unarmed [[Coral Fin|freighter]]. Displaying impressive piloting skills under heavy fire, Kwinn was able to lead both the refugees and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to safety.<ref name="Gamer8" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Extorin Minor skirmishes were introduced in "[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Priapulin|The Priapulin]]," a [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' source article in [[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life (Star Wars Gamer)|''The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life'']] series. The article was published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 8|eighth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="Gamer8" /> on [[December 21]], [[2001]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20011210.html|text=Yuuzhan Vong Invade ''Gamer'' #8}}</ref>
